title: Jean de Langeac, bishop of Avranches, Venice, to Montmorency, 14 Jan 1529, BnF fr. 3083 no. 8 ff. 20-21 (catalogue item 6, Avranches' cipher 1)

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaf or in print found. Lasry decoded the text in 2023 but did not publish it (personal communication, 21 Sept 2026).

transcription.notes: 11 cipher lines. First read by eye from line strips against Lasry's table (no sign file kept); transcribed sign by sign on 14 Nov 2026 in texts/fr3083_no8_cipher_signs.txt, each sign named by the matching cell of Lasry's table: 437 signs counted by script (434 labelled, of which 6 not valued or doubtful, and three not identified in l. 7; one struck sign left out).

system.summary: Simple substitution on graphic signs with a few homophones (two A, two S, two V signs), LL and SS signs, an LE ligature and a macron for n ('Avranches' cipher 1', Lasry's table; sibling fr. 3005 f. 107).
system.sibling_key: Lasry's 2023 table 'Avranches' cipher 1' on cryptiana GL.htm (= Tomokiyo's partial table from fr. 3005 f. 107, img/francisAvranches1.png); applied with refinements.
system.notes: Refinements from the leaf: the ɓ-shaped sign serves P and I; the long-tailed 9 serves A and V; 8∞ = LE; macron over ∞ = en. The block opens with two nulls.

prior_solution.where: Key published online by Lasry (table dated 5 Nov 2023 on cryptiana GL.htm; Tomokiyo's partial table on francis.htm). Lasry also decoded this letter in 2023, unpublished (Lasry, 21 Sept 2026).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the catalogue item; no target-specific intervention recorded. Relayed Lasry's 21 Sept 2026 correction on his unpublished decipherments.

solution.what: Matched the four items against Tomokiyo's francis.htm and GL.htm: four letters, four different keys, all tabulated by Lasry in 2023; no plaintext on either site.
Located the correct Gallica arks (fr. 3091 is btv1b9060253s, not the catalogue's) and fetched full-resolution canvases.
Applied Lasry's 'Avranches' cipher 1' table to the 11 cipher lines of f. 21r by eye from line strips; the block opens MONSEIGNEVR DE SAINCT POL.
Read the cipher in full apart from a group of 3-4 signs before 'sans' and 2 signs before VNG; refined the table (ɓ = P/I, long-tailed 9 = A/V, 8∞ = LE, macron = n).
Dated to 14 Jan 1529 by Saint-Pol's command in Lombardy and the clear news of Aquila retaken in the Abruzzi campaign of winter 1528-29.

Correction from George Lasry: he decoded all four texts in 2023 when reconstructing the keys, but the decipherments were never published. Prior-solution record updated: a reading existed, unpublished, learned of after the reading and not used (only his keys were).

Split the combined catalogue item 6 entry under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): four letters in four keys. gramont1529 keeps fr. 3091 no. 23 (Gramont's cipher 1529); langeac1529 takes fr. 3083 no. 8 (Avranches' cipher 1); gramont1530 takes fr. 3071 no. 7 (Gramont's cipher 1530); the Mâcon letter fr. 3071 no. 4 moved to rome1536 with the other letters in Mascon's cipher. This entry is fr3083_no8_langeac.md, moved from targets/gramont1529/.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): langeac1529: reading fr3083_no8_langeac.md linked; key = Lasry's table image img/BnF_fr3083_f20.png and texts/key.md (refinements copied verbatim from the reading file). No ciphertext transcription exists in the folder.

Fetched Gallica image f36 (openapi.bnf.fr IIIF, full size) and transcribed the 11 cipher lines sign by sign, each sign named by the cell of Lasry's table it matches (texts/fr3083_no8_cipher_signs.txt). Decoding the labels gives the reading of fr3083_no8_langeac.md, with these differences on the page: RECHER SON (no second CHER), RVIN DES, a 7-shaped sign for the N of EMPRINSE(S) twice, no clear S sign in TOVS, an extra T after TROP; in consentement the N is the ordinary N sign.

outcome.method_basis: Read with Lasry's 2023 table 'Avranches' cipher 1' for this letter (cryptiana GL.htm); no new cryptanalysis.

Withdrawn: 0.987 (14 Oct 2026, plaintext letters of the reading file against about 6 unread signs).

texts.label: BnF fr. 3083 no. 8, ff. 20-21, Venice, 14 Jan [1529]
texts.summary: Langeac, bishop of Avranches and ambassador at Venice, reports that Saint-Pol, commanding the French army in Lombardy, asked leave of the Seigneurie, which refused and protested it would be the total ruin of the enterprises; Langeac sees no reason for him to go, given the Milan enterprise, the Spaniards coming with money and the approach of spring, and has written to dissuade him (January 1529, before Landriano).
texts.note: Transcription added 14 Nov 2026: the 11 cipher lines sign by sign, each sign named by the cell of Lasry's table it matches (texts/fr3083_no8_cipher_signs.txt; a single AI transcription from Gallica image f36, not checked by a person; 437 signs, 428 of them read as letters). Decoded label by label it gives the text of fr3083_no8_langeac.md. Lasry's own 2023 decipherment is unpublished and not in the repository.
